ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Topo to use the camera for QR code scanning.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Topo connects to the desktop app on your LAN.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Topo to use your microphone for voice dictation, transcribed on this phone or on your paired computer.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Topo to save images from your sessions to Photos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Topo to attach photos from your library to a terminal session on your paired desktop.
